description.narrative: Output 2.3: By 2026, Government and partners at national and sub-national level have increased capacity to deliver equitable and gender responsive evidence-based programmes for early detection and treatment of child wasting in all settings. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Early detection and treatment of malnutrition,Prevention of stunting and other forms of malnutrition,Detection and treatment of child wasting,Prevention of anemia, low birthweight, overweight, and other forms of malnutrition,Cross sectoral - Research,Cross sectoral - Operations support to programme delivery
